# VAE Research

Use with `purchase-research` when available.

## Safety boundary
Research only. Do not change system, OS, networking, Hermes configuration or install software. Do not create/update skills without explicit user authorization.

## Procedure
1. Establish budget, rider/passenger weights, terrain, distances, hills, cargo, car transport, SAV priority and region.
2. Explore relevant architectures: trekking, compact cargo, longtail, fatbike, utility MTB.
3. Load `references/audit-grid.md`.
4. Separate payload, GVW/PTAC, passenger limit and rack limit.
5. Verify EU/French VAE compliance and certificates when relevant.
6. Research real-world range, climbing, braking, loaded stability and trail behavior.
7. Audit baskets, racks, panniers, trailers and battery options.
8. For car racks, verify bike weight without battery, wheelbase, tire width and per-rail limit.
9. Audit warranty, French service network, standard/proprietary parts and replacement battery.
10. Research current subsidies from official sources.
11. Use multiple scenarios if touring, cargo and off-road needs conflict.
12. Produce a sourced comparison; mark ambiguous manufacturer claims `TO CONFIRM`.
